scripts.name: Simulator build
scripts.command: scripts/build-native.sh simulator && xcodebuild build -project App/Tsk.xcodeproj -scheme Tsk -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath .build/t3-simulator CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

scripts.name: Agent integration checks
scripts.command: env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE bash -c 'python3 scripts/test-agent-dispatch.py && python3 scripts/test-agent-hooks.py && python3 scripts/test-remote-ios.py'
